I cannot help but think, and I have seen comments indicating such, that had they spent a little more time thinking through the initial presentation of the project, the initial kickstarter project page, this project could have more momentum.  When everyone's first response is excitement followed by brakes slamming and "huh?" When you get to the fantasy themed races, that cannot be good for first impressions.  Follow that with a complete lack of any significant explanation of game play on that first day and you have a lot of people that looked and moved on, probably not to return. I am backing the game plus minis because I have had great times with Sentinels and am sure it will be fun, but for anyone not familiR with >G that was not an easy sell with that setup. 

I think they have realized what a mistake those things were and have made corrections, but I think this thing would have been so different if the had taken just a bit more time and reflected on their presentation.  I think the game itself and the stretch goals look solid enough and I get the need for a more toned down project if they lost money on the ST project, I just think a lot of the momentum problems could have been curbed with better salesmanship from the outset.

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
More Q&A!

What is the retail price of GSF?

$39.95

Cause I just remembered since you are using the same delivery system as ST KS campaign?

We are using the same shipper (FedEx). However, we anticipate being able to ship everything out much more quickly without as much of a time lag this time.

Is everyone also getting charged $10 for delivery (for in states) cause someone brought up a good point that GSF is more expensive than SOTM. Unless this is the planned course.

We are charging $10 for shipping for GSF, exactly like we have done for every single Kickstarter we have run to date. If you look at the IR/EE Kickstarter from last spring, you will see that the cost for getting the GSF core game via this Kickstarter campaign is exactly the same as the cost for getting Enhanced Edition from that campaign. 

Are miniatures planned for future expansions of GSF?

Yes. Every GSF expansion will also be released with optional miniatures. 

Not sure if its possible, but is it possible for you to take your "funds" you received for playtesting you got as a side bonus and boost the stretch goal?

Yes, we are definitely doing this!

I just think a lot of the momentum problems could have been curbed with better salesmanship from the outset. 

You are right, there are definitely things that could have been constructed better with regards to this Kickstarter! Every time we run them, we learn new things. With Rook City, we learned what sorts of levels people care about and what sorts they don't. On IR/EE, we learned that offering stretch rewards as "add money to your pledge" add-ons (what we did with Unity) is a huge hassle for us and also irritates people. On ST, we learned that there is definitely such a thing as too much complication when it comes to stretch rewards. And for GSF, we are learning the difference in expectations from fans between a Kickstarter for an expansions vs a Kickstarter for a brand new game. We did not run a Kickstarter for the original SotM, so this is our very first time trying it out with a new game.

However, we are thrilled to have funded, and intend to keep releasing more information about the game as the Kickstart progresses (including some stuff about the box, probably early next week once we have 100% solid information from the printer, etc). Right now, our primary goal is making GSF an awesome game!
